latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the bookforge-authentication-security-assessment skill.

- Provides systematic assessment of web application authentication mechanisms for design and implementation flaws.
- Includes guidance for both black-box (behavioral) and white-box (source code) testing.
- Maps findings to OWASP Testing Guide and relevant CWE categories (287, 521, 307, 640, 312, 522).
- Defines required context, assessment tasks, input types, and intended audience (penetration testers, security engineers, developers).
- Outlines supported authentication surfaces: login, password change, account recovery, registration, and multistage mechanisms.
- Excludes authorization testing, session token analysis, and injection attack assessment.
